body: `toLogical` doesn't communicate with rust at all, what is the type of `size`

> `toLogical` doesn't communicate with rust at all, what is the type of `size`

The actual type returned by `innerSize()` is a plain object with keys `height` and `width`. However, typescript thinks the object returned from `innerSize()` is a`PhysicalSize` object which is a class with methods that has  a`toLogical` method. So i think the mapping between Tauri backend and the javascript frontend types is off.

if typescript thinks the object is `PhysicalSize` and it has `toLogical()` method, then I see no problem as this is the intended behavior.

Tauri's backend and Rust has no role in this as `toLogical()` is purely executed in js only.

No, the problem is, the function is defined as `async innerPosition(): Promise<PhysicalPosition>`, but instead of an instance of the PhysicalSize class ([window.ts#L116-130](https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/blob/dev/tooling/api/src/window.ts#L116-L130)) it returns a plain `{width: a, height: b}`

> if typescript thinks the object is `PhysicalSize` and it has `toLogical()` method, then I see no problem as this is the intended behavior.
> 
> Tauri's backend and Rust has no role in this as `toLogical()` is purely executed in js only.

The return type is wrong in the javascript function.  You can either make the javascript create a new instance of a PhysicalSize and return this. Or change the return type.

Ah yes, I see the problem now, we are indeed just returning a plain object instead of an instance of a class.

Should've read your words more carefully, apologies.
If there isn't anyone already working on it, I'll give it a shot as my first contribution

### Describe the bug

```typescript
const monitor = await currentMonitor()
if (monitor) {
  const { size, scaleFactor } = monitor
  size.toLogical(scaleFactor); // <--- [Error] toLogical does not exist on size
}
```

I have searched and read #2599 and #2621, and I think if we return a `Monitor` instance [here](https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/blob/43348652662fad65914959829073e6ba08cc412d/tooling/api/src/window.ts#L1221):
```typescript
/**
 * Returns the monitor on which the window currently resides.
 * Returns `null` if current monitor can't be detected.
 */
async function currentMonitor(): Promise<Monitor | null> {
  return invokeTauriCommand({
    __tauriModule: 'Window',
    message: {
      cmd: 'manage',
      data: {
        cmd: {
          type: 'currentMonitor'
        }
      }
    }
  })
} // .then(res => new Monitor( ... ))
```
this problem might be solved.
